basis: Actual normal-GUI source-matched ten-second preflight receipts from both selected directions, with source display and default mixed formatting preserved. These are observed field roles, not semantic accuracy, complete delivery or universal packet relationships.

observations.format: Japanese translation, a single space, parenthesized English recognized source; trailing OSC arguments true,false; zero newlines in these observed messages
Korean translation, a single space, parenthesized Chinese recognized source; trailing OSC arguments true,false; zero newlines in these observed messages

source_format_evidence.composition: The selected branch calls OscChatbox.SendMessage($"{translated} ({recognized})", true). The formatter does not escape delimiter parentheses.
source_format_evidence.other_modes: SpeechToTextOnly sends recognized; TranslationOnly sends translated. Neither alternate mode was selected for these receipts. Bare payloads are not automatically assigned those modes.
source_format_evidence.empty_fields: The mixed branch can produce " (recognized)" when translation is empty and "translated ()" when recognized source is empty. These are source-derived boundary cases, not extra observed preflight packets.
source_format_evidence.typing: SetIsTyping(!final) is sent separately. With default waiting enabled, nonfinal chatbox input is suppressed. Neither typing state nor observed order establishes common endpoint finality, completeness or relationships.
source_format_evidence.delegation_limit: Chatbox.Send delegates message transport to its OSC library. No universal library truncation, paging or completeness guarantee follows from the inspected formatter.

rule.uncertainty: Bounded mixed-mode field framing only. Empty extracted translation is known source-only/nontranslation, with raw and source retained; a nonempty target with empty source is permitted by the formatter. Literal, nested, extra or unmatched delimiter parentheses are not universally decodable: nonmatching packets must remain ROLE unknown, not full mixed text treated as translation and not known source-only/empty translation. Preserve raw packet/order and rule provenance; require genuine input-bound interpretation evidence before granting unknown-role text translated-output alignment or judging. No universal utterance, revision, erasure, resend, pagination or finality semantics are established; typing does not establish finality. Source is application recognition, not reference truth.

required_uncertainty_boundary.matching: Use full-message matching, equivalent to re.fullmatch(text_pattern, payload, re.DOTALL), only for the recorded mixed mode.
required_uncertainty_boundary.empty_translation: Retain raw and recognized source as known source-only/nontranslation; do not count it as translated content.
required_uncertainty_boundary.empty_source: A nonempty extracted translation with empty recognized source is allowed.
required_uncertainty_boundary.pattern_mismatch: Literal, nested, extra or unmatched delimiter parentheses cannot be universally decoded. Preserve an unresolved ROLE-unknown observation and raw receipt, distinct from known source-only and known translated output. Never treat the complete mixed-role payload as translation or silently turn uncertainty into empty translation.
required_uncertainty_boundary.relationships: No preflight receipt creates an utterance, revision, erasure, resend, page or finality relationship.
required_uncertainty_boundary.implementation_status: This record states the observed format and required uncertainty boundary. It does not certify ambiguous-case behavior of the interpreter: the reproduced legacy mismatch fallback is assigned for repair before freeze. No ambiguous-case fix or scoring readiness is claimed here.

known_matching_payload_smoke.scope: One pure existing-interpreter call over all seven actual selected public-export chatbox receipts: three KIKI1 and four KIKI2. No synthetic ambiguous cases, models, providers, alignment, quality or GUI were exercised.
known_matching_payload_smoke.command: Existing .data/check-venv/Scripts/python.exe -c; the in-memory program loaded the seven exact exported receipt events and these unchanged rule objects, invoked interpret once, and asserted actual source/translation fields, unchanged raw events, seven outputs, zero nontranslation observations and unknown relationships.

public_export_integrity_basis: Reuse the accepted independent app-readiness inspection of all24 native/derivative file pairs across the four named public exports: all hashes passed, with no payload or numeric changes. The native/public trace hashes and exact identities above come from their existing export-provenance and receipt records; no new export or privacy certification was manufactured.
binding_policy: Preflight clock sessions, receive sequences, timestamps and trace lines identify evidence only. Never copy them as main-run relationships or alignment links. Future correspondence or role resolution requires genuine exact input/output-bound evidence under the separately frozen method.
